name: FUN_DS_DATA_ROLE_TMPL_AUDIT
description: This table contains information about seeded data role templates and their seeded content. This is a persistent table that includes base roles and seeded policies. These details are needed to identify which data roles to upgrade and which grants to end date.

columns.name: DATA_ROLE_TMPL_AUDIT_ID
columns.description: Record identifier for data role templates.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_FULL_PATH
columns.description: Full directory path for the data role template file.

columns.name: DIMENSION_OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: Object name corresponding to the security dimension of the data role template.

columns.name: BASE_ROLE_NAME
columns.description: Base role included in this data role template.

columns.name: DATABASE_OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: Object name corresponding to the data security policy for the base role.

columns.name: INSTANCE_TYPE
columns.description: Type of data secuirty policy for this base role and object.

columns.name: INSTANCE_SET_NAME
columns.description: Instance set used by the data security policy for this base role and object.

columns.name: DIMENSION_VALUE_COLUMN
columns.description: Displays dimension value. For instance of type INSTANCE, it displays INSTANCE_PKx_VALUE. For instance of type SET, it displays PARAMETERx.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
